arxiv-2112-04176.title: Mobile BCI dataset of scalp- and ear-EEGs with ERP and SSVEP paradigms while standing, walking, and running
arxiv-2112-04176.creator: Young-Eun Lee, Gi-Hwan Shin, Minji Lee, Seong-Whan Lee
arxiv-2112-04176.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Young-Eun Lee, Gi-Hwan Shin, Minji Lee, Seong-Whan Lee. We present a mobile dataset obtained from electroencephalography (EEG) of the scalp and around the ear as well as from locomotion sensors by 24 participants moving at four different speeds while performing two brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks. The data were collected from 32-channel scalp-EEG, 14-channel ear-EEG, 4-channel electrooculography, and 9-channel inertial measurement units placed at the forehead, left ankle, and right ankle.

arxiv-2203-10617.title: explicit formulae for rank zero DT invariants and the OSV conjecture
arxiv-2203-10617.creator: Soheyla Feyzbakhsh
arxiv-2203-10617.description: Abstract . Fix a Calabi-Yau 3-fold X X satisfying the Bogomolov-Gieseker conjecture of Bayer-Macrì-Toda, such as the quintic 3-fold. By two different wall-crossing arguments we prove two different explicit formulae relating rank 0 Donaldson-Thomas invariants (counting torsion sheaves on X X supported on ample divisors) in terms of rank 1 Donaldson-Thomas invariants (counting ideal sheaves of curves) and Pandharipande-Thomas invariants.

arxiv-2406-13938.title: Coverage of Credible Sets for Regression under Variable Selection
arxiv-2406-13938.creator: Samhita Pal
arxiv-2406-13938.description: Abstract We study the asymptotic frequentist coverage of credible sets based on a novel Bayesian approach for a multiple linear regression model under variable selection. We initially ignore the issue of variable selection, which allows us to put a conjugate normal prior on the coefficient vector.

arxiv-2408-09500.title: Black hole thermodynamics from an ensemble-averaged theory
arxiv-2408-09500.creator: Peng Cheng 1, Yu-Xiao Liu 2, Shao-Wen Wei 2
arxiv-2408-09500.description: Abstract The path integral approach to a quantum theory of gravity is widely regarded as an indispensable strategy. However, determining what additional elements, beyond black hole or AdS spacetime, should be incorporated into the path integral remains crucial yet perplexing.

arxiv-2410-18853.title: Holography of dislocations and ring defects in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity
arxiv-2410-18853.creator: Vladimir Juričić, Olivera Miskovic, Francisca Ramírez Carrasco
arxiv-2410-18853.description: Abstract We study torsional topological defects in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity in ( 4 + 1 4+1 )-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetime. In the holographic interpretation, these correspond to crystalline dislocation defects associated with the discrete lattice translational symmetry. The Gauss-Bonnet coupling is fixed at the Chern-Simons point.

arxiv-2501-11448.title: An accuracy-runtime trade-off comparison of scalable Gaussian process approximations for spatial data
arxiv-2501-11448.creator: Filippo Rambelli, Fabio Sigrist
arxiv-2501-11448.description: Abstract Gaussian processes (GPs) are flexible, probabilistic, nonparametric models widely used in fields such as spatial statistics and machine learning. A drawback of Gaussian processes is their computational cost, with 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 3 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{3}) time and 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) memory complexity, which makes them prohibitive for large data sets.

pmc-11433070.creator: Feng Huang, Jinfeng Ling, Yiping Cui, Bin Guo, Xiaobing Song, Shimin Zuo, Xuehong Wu, Lihua Guo
pmc-11433070.description: Plant endophytic microbial communities consist of many latent plant pathogens and, also, many pathogen-related species with reduced virulence. pmc-11492156.title: Comparing CD10 Expression With the Clinicopathological Features and Hormone Status of Invasive Breast Cancer
pmc-11492156.creator: Aravindan Kumaravel, Muthuvel Esakki
pmc-11492156.description: BackgroundWorldwide, female breast cancer is the most common cancer (11.7%), followed by lung (11.4%), colorectal, prostate, and stomach. Breast cancer is the fifth most common cause of cancer-related mortality, with lung cancer being the leading cause. In India, breast and cervical cancers are the two most common cancers among women.

pmc-11495030.title: Genetic requirements for uropathogenic E. coli proliferation in the bladder cell infection cycle
pmc-11495030.creator: Daniel G. Mediati, Tamika A. Blair, Ariana Costas, Leigh G. Monahan, Bill Söderström, Ian G. Charles, Iain G. Duggin
pmc-11495030.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC) requires an adaptable physiology to survive the wide range of environments experienced in the host, including gut and urinary tract surfaces. To identify UPEC genes required during intracellular infection, we developed a transposon-directed insertion-site sequencing approach for cellular infection models and searched for genes in a library of ~20,000 UTI89 transposon-insertion mutants that are specifically required at the distinct stages of infection of cultured bladder epithelial cells.

pmc-13008900.title: The clinical trial landscape of osteosarcoma: integrating trial data, immunotherapeutic trends, and biomarker insights
pmc-13008900.creator: Lifeng Ge, Tianhao Xu, Xiaodong Gu, Xuekang Pan, Tian Gao, Huigen Lu
pmc-13008900.description: Osteosarcoma, the most aggressive primary malignant bone tumor, has stagnant therapeutic outcomes despite decades of standard MAP chemotherapy and surgery; 5-year overall survival (OS) is <30% for metastatic/recurrent cases. Plagued by genomic heterogeneity, immunosuppressive TME, and low immunogenicity, emerging immunotherapies lack robust large-scale clinical validation. We systematically analyzed 864 interventional osteosarcoma trials from Trialtrove (as of September 2025).
